summary.zh-CN: 聊天现在可以引用已登记项目，同时改进 Codex 会话连续性、默认执行权限和 Marketplace 卸载安全。
summary.en-US: Chat can now reference registered projects, with improved Codex continuity, default execution access, and Marketplace uninstall safety.

body.zh-CN: 在聊天输入框的 @ 菜单中选择已登记项目，把项目名称、路径和受限目录概览加入本次消息，同时保持当前会话工作目录不变。
body.en-US: Select a registered project from the chat composer’s @ menu to add its name, path, and bounded directory overview to the current message without changing the conversation’s working directory.

body.zh-CN: 持续的命令输出会被视为活跃；真正超时后仍保留原 thread 身份，下一轮恢复同一会话。
body.en-US: Ongoing command output counts as activity, and a real timeout preserves the existing thread identity for the next turn.

body.zh-CN: Codex 会话默认使用完整本地执行权限和无审批策略，避免在审批交互尚不可用时继承只读配置。
body.en-US: Codex conversations default to full local execution access with approvals disabled instead of inheriting read-only settings while approval interaction is unavailable.

body.zh-CN: 停止当前回复并开始执行排队消息时，该消息会立即从输入框队列移除。
body.en-US: A queued message leaves the composer queue as soon as stopping the current reply starts it.

body.zh-CN: Marketplace 只允许卸载 workspace skills 目录下由它管理的直属 skill，并拒绝路径越界目标。
body.en-US: Marketplace only uninstalls direct skills it manages under the workspace skills directory and rejects path escape targets.

body.zh-CN: 现有 NPM 安装可以直接通过 stable 通道升级，不需要迁移配置、会话或文件。
body.en-US: Existing npm installations can update through the stable channel without migrating configuration, sessions, or files.
